author: Brent Rossow
releaseNotes: Fixes false newLifetimeSpeciesDetected alerts for species you have already seen. The BirdWeather species endpoint silently caps results at 100 and returns them most-detected first, so the driver only ever tracked your 100 commonest birds and re-alerted on everything rarer. The all-time list is now read page by page, merged rather than overwritten, never cleared by an empty or failed response, and refreshed hourly instead of every poll.
